scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && pnpm --filter buggy-shop typecheck && pnpm --filter inspect-lab typecheck && pnpm --filter @exegezis/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @exegezis/site typecheck
scripts.test: tsc -b && vitest run && pnpm --filter buggy-shop test && pnpm --filter buggy-shop test:known-bugs
scripts.verify: node scripts/run-mode.mjs local "pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test"
scripts.web: pnpm install --prefer-offline && pnpm build && node scripts/run-mode.mjs local pnpm --filter @exegezis/web dev
scripts.web:cloud: pnpm install --prefer-offline && pnpm build && node scripts/run-mode.mjs cloud pnpm --filter @exegezis/web dev
